Absorption Weaponry

Toshu (InuYasha) forged the Dakki, a blade that can absorb Yoki.

Power/Ability to:

Create and/or use weapons capable of absorption.

The power to create and/or use weapons capable of absorption. Variation of Absorption Object and Power Weaponry.

Capabilities[]

The user can create and/or use weaponry capable of absorption.

Applications[]

  • Absorption Infusion
  • Absorption

Variations[]

  • Absorption Blade Construction
    • Absorption Sword Proficiency
  • Absorption Polearm Construction
  • Absorption Ranged Weaponry
    • Absorption Bow Construction
    • Absorption Gun Construction
  • Absorption Whip Generation

Associations[]

  • Absorption
  • Power Weaponry

Limitations[]

  • May be limited to absorbing certain things, like life-force or elements.
  • Absorption Immunity/Absorption Negation

Known Users[]

  • Various Shinobi (Black Sun)
    • Sango Yasuke
    • Sango Sekiryu
  • Tatsu Toro Yamashiro/Katana (DC Comics); via Soultaker Sword
  • Android 21 (Dragon Ball FighterZ)
  • Harkon (The Elder Scrolls V: Dawnguard); via Harkon's Sword
  • Haknir Death-Brand (The Elder Scrolls V: Dragonborn); via Bloodscythe and Soulrender
  • Miyamoto Mamoru (Infinite Leveling: Murim)
  • Dan Yuseong (Infinite Leveling: Murim)
  • Kain (Legacy of Kain)
  • Raziel (Legacy of Kain)
  • King Kong (Monsterverse)
  • Kisame Hoshigaki (Naruto)

Known Objects[]

  • Devourers (Black Sun)
  • Spirit-Eater (The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind)
  • Ghost Weapons (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
  • Dragon-scaled Tessaiga (InuYasha)
  • Soul Reaver (Legacy of Kain)
  • Kong's Battle Axe (Monsterverse)
  • Jutsu Absorption Arm (Naruto); via Absorption Spheres
  • Samehada (Naruto)
  • Dark Dragon Blade (Ninja Gaiden)
  • Savage Sword (Power Rangers)
  • Soul Edge (Soul series)
  • Gengetsu (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: Battle Nexus)

Gallery[]

Anime/Manga/Manhwa[]

Jūshirō Ukitake (Bleach) using his Sōgyo no Kotowari to absorb energy attacks with one sword and fire it back with amplified force through the other.
Nozomi Kujō (Bleach) using her Arazome Shigure to absorb spiritual energy and is then free to use it as she pleases.

Comics[]

Ice Hand's (Black Sun) Devourer.
Ghost Hand's (Black Sun) Devourer.
The Soultaker (DC Comics) steals the souls of those it kills.

Live Action TV/Movies[]

The Savage Sword (Power Rangers) can absorb the energy of anything, or anyone cut by its blade, increasing the power of its wielder, changing itself into a stronger form...
...and healing the wielder.
Kong (Godzilla vs Kong) using his battle axe.

Video Games[]

Android 21 (Dragon Ball FighterZ) using the Connoisseur Cut, an energy blade that allows her to absorb energy from an opponent and copy their techniques.
The Soul Reaver (Legacy of Kain) steals the souls of its victims...
...and in its original form, was enchanted with vampiric energy, allowing it to drain their blood.
Slashuur's (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: Battle Nexus) scythe, Gengetsu, drains his opponents' life force and feeds it to its wielder.
Nightmare (Soul Calibur) wields the Soul Edge, which steals the souls of those it kills.
